text:
Anna Chen: Afternoon handoff — cut is in ~2h. Quick runthrough:
- Cherries: kv-cache-fix (cherry/kv-cache-fix) PR #1245, telemetry-rename PR #1246
- Canary: rolling 2 nodes in us-east-1, 5% traffic
- Blockers: macos CI flaky on kv-cache PR causing merge hold
- Need: one more +1 on #1245 and a perf sanity from Devon
Anyone taking overnight oncall after cut?

Devon Patel: I'm reproing the tail-latency bump locally. Might be caused by the batching changes. I have a perf run scheduled: `perf/run.sh --suite=tail-latency --seed=42`. If I can't reproduce in 30m I'll revert the batching tweak in the cherry and re-run.

Michael Ortiz: CI rerun requested, queued by deploy-bot. If CI passes I can merge. If it flakes again we can fallback to previous kernel selection flag: `--kernel=v1.9`. Ping me for manual merge.

Sophia Li: FYI, console alert showed a spike in tokenization errors on the canary earlier, I collected logs: `s3://rwd-logs/1807501234/tokenizer-spike.log`. Might be unrelated but flagging.

release-captain-bot: Canary rollout at 5% started 2026-03-17T15:10:00Z. Monitors: ok. Latency: +2ms median, tail +15ms.

Anna Chen: Thanks. Plan: wait for CI, Devon to confirm perf. If both good we merge and promote canary to 25% at +30m. If not, roll back cherry and proceed with other non-blocking cherries.

Devon Patel: Update: reproduced tail bump with current build. Root cause looks like KV cache eviction policy interacting with batching. I'll push a fix branch `cherry/kv-cache-evict-fix` in ~45m. @Michael Ortiz hold merge.

Michael Ortiz: Hold acknowledged. I'll keep merge button cold. :thumbsup:

Riley Gomez: (oncall) I can take overnight if we ship. Otherwise I'll be standby for rollback.

Anna Chen: Great. If we need emergency rollback the plan is `release-captain-bot rollback --target=stable --reason="kv-cache tail latency"`. Keep this thread updated.

Sophia Li: Added checks to the canary dashboard to alert at +10% tail. Also created an eval promptset to validate correctness.

Anna Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short update in #eng-releases when we either merge or rollback.
